# Data Lakehouse Architecture – Pipeline & Governance

## Overview
This dataset describes a modern data lakehouse architecture following the medallion pattern (Bronze → Silver → Gold). It captures 10 data sources across 5 categories, 3 ingestion modes, 5 medallion-layer datasets per tier, 6 consumption endpoints, 15 governance controls, and transformation summaries per layer.

## Data Source

### architecture_nodes
Each record represents a component in the architecture. Fields: `node_id` (string, unique identifier), `label` (display name), `layer` (one of: source, ingestion, bronze, silver, gold, consumption), `category` (grouping within layer), `daily_volume_gb` (numeric or null for consumption nodes), `format` (data format or technology). 34 nodes total.

### architecture_edges
Directed edges between nodes. Fields: `edge_id` (string), `source` and `target` (node_id references), `volume_gb` (numeric or null), `mode` (streaming | batch | cdc | query), `latency` (descriptive string). 38 edges total.

### governance_controls
Governance policies applied per layer. Fields: `control_id`, `layer` (architecture layer or cross-layer), `control_type`, `tool`, `scope`, `enforcement` (automated | policy-based | manual | scheduled). 15 records.

### transformation_summary
Counts of transformation types per medallion layer. Fields: `layer`, `transformation_type`, `count` (integer), `complexity` (low | medium | high). 12 records across bronze, silver, and gold.

## Data Notes
- Volume figures are illustrative daily averages; actual volumes vary by day.
- Some bronze volumes exceed source totals due to log fan-out and metadata enrichment.
- Consumption-layer nodes have null volume as they represent query-based access.
- Governance controls tagged as "cross-layer" apply to the entire pipeline.

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data['architecture_nodes']['data']
edges_data = data['architecture_edges']['data']
governance_data = data['governance_controls']['data']
transformations_data = data['transformation_summary']['data']

# ── Color palette ──
layer_colors = {
    'source':     '#2E6DA4',
    'ingestion':  '#D97B28',
    'bronze':     '#8B5E3C',
    'silver':     '#7B8D8E',
    'gold':       '#C9A827',
    'consumption':'#3A8F5C',
}

layer_bg = {
    'source':     '#D6E8F5',
    'ingestion':  '#FCE8D0',
    'bronze':     '#E8D5C0',
    'silver':     '#DDE3E3',
    'gold':       '#F0E8C8',
    'consumption':'#D4EDDC',
}

source_cat_colors = {
    'IoT/Streaming':      '#2E6DA4',
    'Enterprise Apps':    '#5BA3CF',
    'Logs/Clickstream':   '#3A8F5C',
    'External/3rd Party': '#D4A843',
    'Databases':          '#8B5E8B',
}

consumption_cat_colors = {
    'BI':         '#3A8F5C',
    'ML':         '#2E6DA4',
    'API':        '#D97B28',
    'Reverse ETL':'#8B5E8B',
}

complexity_colors = {'low': '#7CB342', 'medium': '#FFB300', 'high': '#E53935'}

enforcement_colors = {
    'automated': '#2E6DA4',
    'policy-based': '#D97B28',
    'manual': '#888888',
    'scheduled': '#3A8F5C',
}

# ── Organize data ──
layers_ordered = ['source', 'ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption']
nodes_by_layer = {layer: [] for layer in layers_ordered}
for n in nodes_data:
    nodes_by_layer[n['layer']].append(n)

node_map = {n['node_id']: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Create figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(24, 14), facecolor='white')

# GridSpec: main Sankey area (left 70%), transformation panel (top-right 15%), governance panel (bottom-right 15%)
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[2.5, 1], height_ratios=[1, 1],
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.92, bottom=0.05,
                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.12)

ax_sankey = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_xform = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Sankey-style Alluvial Flow Diagram
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_sankey.set_xlim(-0.5, 6.5)
ax_sankey.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)
ax_sankey.axis('off')

# Column x positions for each layer
col_x = {'source': 0, 'ingestion': 1.2, 'bronze': 2.4, 'silver': 3.6, 'gold': 4.8, 'consumption': 6.0}

# Draw layer background bands
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.42, -0.3), 0.84, 11.1,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                          facecolor=layer_bg[layer], edgecolor=layer_colors[layer],
                          linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax_sankey.add_patch(rect)

# Layer header labels
layer_labels = {
    'source': 'SOURCE\nLAYER',
    'ingestion': 'INGESTION\nENGINE',
    'bronze': 'BRONZE\n(Raw)',
    'silver': 'SILVER\n(Curated)',
    'gold': 'GOLD\n(Business)',
    'consumption': 'CONSUMPTION\nENDPOINTS',
}

layer_volume_totals = {}
for n in nodes_data:
    layer = n['layer']
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb') or 0
    layer_volume_totals[layer] = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0) + vol

for layer, x in col_x.items():
    total_vol = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0)
    vol_text = f"{total_vol:,} GB/day" if total_vol > 0 else "Query-based"
    ax_sankey.text(x, 10.5, layer_labels[layer], ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=layer_colors[layer], zorder=5)
    ax_sankey.text(x, 9.6, vol_text, ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=6.5, fontstyle='italic', color='#555555', zorder=5)

# Position nodes vertically within each column
node_positions = {}
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    layer_nodes = nodes_by_layer[layer]
    n_nodes = len(layer_nodes)
    y_space = 8.5 / max(n_nodes, 1)
    y_start = 8.8
    for i, n in enumerate(layer_nodes):
        y = y_start - i * y_space
        node_positions[n['node_id']] = (x, y)

# Draw nodes as colored rectangles
node_rect_height = 0.55
for n in nodes_data:
    x, y = node_positions[n['node_id']]
    if n['layer'] == 'source':
        color = source_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['source'])
    elif n['layer'] == 'consumption':
        color = consumption_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['consumption'])
    else:
        color = layer_colors[n['layer']]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.38, y - node_rect_height/2), 0.76, node_rect_height,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.03",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='white',
                          linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
    ax_sankey.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb')
    label_text = n['label']
    if vol:
        label_text += f"\n{vol} GB/d"
    ax_sankey.text(x, y, label_text, ha='center', va='center',
                   fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=4,
                   path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0.5, foreground='#00000040')])

# Draw edges as curved connections with width proportional to volume
max_vol = max((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)

for e in edges_data:
    src_x, src_y = node_positions[e['source']]
    tgt_x, tgt_y = node_positions[e['target']]
    vol = e.get('volume_gb')
    if vol:
        line_width = 0.5 + 4.0 * (vol / max_vol)
        alpha = 0.15 + 0.35 * (vol / max_vol)
    else:
        line_width = 0.5
        alpha = 0.15

    src_layer = node_map[e['source']]['layer']
    color = layer_colors[src_layer]

    # Draw bezier-like curve
    mid_x = (src_x + tgt_x) / 2
    xs = np.linspace(src_x + 0.38, tgt_x - 0.38, 50)
    # Cubic bezier approximation
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, 50)
    ctrl1_x = src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.35
    ctrl2_x = src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.65
    ys = ((1-t)**3 * src_y + 3*(1-t)**2*t * src_y +
          3*(1-t)*t**2 * tgt_y + t**3 * tgt_y)

    ax_sankey.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=line_width, alpha=alpha,
                   solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

# Draw flow mode labels between layers
mode_labels = [
    (0.5, 'Streaming\nBatch\nCDC', '#555555'),
    (1.7, 'Schema\nValidation\nDQ Gates', '#2E6DA4'),
    (2.9, 'Dedup\nCleanse\nNormalize', '#8B5E3C'),
    (4.1, 'Enrich\nJoin\nConform', '#7B8D8E'),
    (5.3, 'Aggregate\nFeature Eng\nKPI Calc', '#C9A827'),
]
for x, text, color in mode_labels:
    ax_sankey.text(x, -0.15, text, ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=5, color=color, fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.7)

# Title for main panel
ax_sankey.text(3.0, 10.9, 'End-to-End Data Flow Pipeline',
               ha='center', va='top', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a')

# Source category legend
legend_items = [
    ('IoT/Streaming', source_cat_colors['IoT/Streaming']),
    ('Enterprise Apps', source_cat_colors['Enterprise Apps']),
    ('Logs/Clickstream', source_cat_colors['Logs/Clickstream']),
    ('External/3rd Party', source_cat_colors['External/3rd Party']),
    ('Databases', source_cat_colors['Databases']),
]
for i, (label, color) in enumerate(legend_items):
    ax_sankey.plot(-0.3, 8.5 - i * 0.45, 's', color=color, markersize=6)
    ax_sankey.text(-0.15, 8.5 - i * 0.45, label, fontsize=5.5, va='center', color='#333333')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Transformation Summary
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_xform.set_title('Transformation Summary by Medallion Layer', fontsize=10,
                    fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=10)

xform_layers = ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']
y_pos = 0
y_ticks = []
y_labels = []
bar_colors_list = []
bar_values = []
bar_positions = []
layer_boundaries = []

for layer in xform_layers:
    layer_xforms = [t for t in transformations_data if t['layer'] == layer]
    layer_start = y_pos
    for t in sorted(layer_xforms, key=lambda x: x['count'], reverse=True):
        bar_positions.append(y_pos)
        bar_values.append(t['count'])
        bar_colors_list.append(complexity_colors[t['complexity']])
        short_name = t['transformation_type']
        if len(short_name) > 30:
            short_name = short_name[:28] + '..'
        y_labels.append(short_name)
        y_ticks.append(y_pos)
        y_pos += 1
    if layer_xforms:
        layer_boundaries.append((layer_start, y_pos - 1, layer))
    y_pos += 0.5

bars = ax_xform.barh(bar_positions, bar_values, height=0.7,
                      color=bar_colors_list, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85)

# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars, bar_values):
    ax_xform.text(bar.get_width() + 0.2, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                  str(val), va='center', fontsize=6.5, color='#333333')

ax_xform.set_yticks(y_ticks)
ax_xform.set_yticklabels(y_labels, fontsize=6)
ax_xform.set_xlabel('Transformation Count', fontsize=7, color='#555555')
ax_xform.invert_yaxis()
ax_xform.set_xlim(0, max(bar_values) + 2)

# Add layer labels on right side
for start, end, layer in layer_boundaries:
    mid = (start + end) / 2
    color = layer_colors[layer]
    ax_xform.text(max(bar_values) + 3, mid, layer.upper(),
                  va='center', ha='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
                  color='white',
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=color, alpha=0.8))

# Complexity legend
for i, (comp, color) in enumerate(complexity_colors.items()):
    ax_xform.text(max(bar_values) + 1.5, len(bar_positions) + 0.5 + i * 0.5,
                  f'■ {comp.title()}', fontsize=6, color=color, va='center')

ax_xform.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_xform.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_xform.spines['bottom'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
ax_xform.spines['left'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
ax_xform.tick_params(axis='both', colors='#666666', labelsize=6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3: Governance Controls
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_gov.set_title('Data Governance Controls by Pipeline Stage', fontsize=10,
                  fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=10)
ax_gov.axis('off')

gov_layers_display = ['ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption', 'cross-layer']
gov_display_names = ['Ingestion', 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Consumption', 'Cross-Layer']

y_pos = 0.95
for i, layer in enumerate(gov_layers_display):
    controls = [g for g in governance_data if g['layer'] == layer]
    layer_color = layer_colors.get(layer, '#555555')

    # Layer header
    display_name = layer.replace('-', ' ').title()
    ax_gov.text(0.0, y_pos, f'▌ {display_name}', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                color=layer_color, va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes)
    y_pos -= 0.045

    for g in controls:
        # Enforcement type indicator
        enf = g['enforcement']
        enf_color = enforcement_colors.get(enf, '#888888')
        enf_marker = {'automated': '●', 'policy-based': '◆', 'manual': '○', 'scheduled': '◔'}.get(enf, '·')

        ax_gov.text(0.03, y_pos, enf_marker, fontsize=7, color=enf_color, va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='bold')
        ax_gov.text(0.06, y_pos, f"{g['control_type']}", fontsize=6.5, color='#333333', va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes)
        ax_gov.text(0.06, y_pos - 0.025, f"{g['tool']}", fontsize=5.5, color='#888888', va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontstyle='italic')
        y_pos -= 0.065

    y_pos -= 0.02

# Enforcement legend
legend_y = y_pos - 0.02
ax_gov.text(0.0, legend_y, 'Enforcement:', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold',
            color='#555555', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes)
legend_items_gov = [
    ('● Automated', enforcement_colors['automated']),
    ('◆ Policy-based', enforcement_colors['policy-based']),
    ('○ Manual', enforcement_colors['manual']),
    ('◔ Scheduled', enforcement_colors['scheduled']),
]
for j, (text, color) in enumerate(legend_items_gov):
    ax_gov.text(0.05 + j * 0.24, legend_y - 0.035, text, fontsize=5.5,
                color=color, va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='bold')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# Main title
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle('Data Lakehouse Architecture — Pipeline Flow, Volume Throughput & Governance',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', y=0.97)

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.3)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

node_rect_height = 0.55
for n in nodes_data:
    x, y = node_positions[n['node_id']]
    if n['layer'] == 'source':
        color = source_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['source'])
    elif n['layer'] == 'consumption':
        color = consumption_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['consumption'])
    else:
        color = layer_colors[n['layer']]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.38, y - node_rect_height/2), 0.76, node_rect_height,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.03",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='white',
                          linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
    ax_sankey.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb')
    label_text = n['label']
    if vol:
        label_text += f"\n{vol} GB/d"
    ax_sankey.text(x, y, label_text, ha='center', va='center',
                   fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=4,
                   path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0.5, foreground='#00000040')])

# Draw edges as curved connections with width proportional to volume
max_vol = max((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)

for e in edges_data:
    src_x, src_y = node_positions[e['source']]
    tgt_x, tgt_y = node_positions[e['target']]
    vol = e.get('volume_gb')
    if vol:
        line_width = 0.5 + 4.0 * (vol / max_vol)
        alpha = 0.15 + 0.35 * (vol / max_vol)
    else:
        line_width = 0.5
        alpha = 0.15

    src_layer = node_map[e['source']]['layer']
    color = layer_colors[src_layer]

    # Draw bezier-like curve
    mid_x = (src_x + tgt_x) / 2
    xs = np.linspace(src_x + 0.38, tgt_x - 0.38, 50)
    # Cubic bezier approximation
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, 50)
    ctrl1_x = src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.35
    ctrl2_x = src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.65
    ys = ((1-t)**3 * src_y + 3*(1-t)**2*t * src_y +
          3*(1-t)*t**2 * tgt_y + t**3 * tgt_y)

    ax_sankey.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=line_width, alpha=alpha,
                   solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

# Draw flow mode labels between layers
mode_labels = [
    (0.5, 'Streaming\nBatch\nCDC', '#555555'),
    (1.7, 'Schema\nValidation\nDQ Gates', '#2E6DA4'),

    (5.3, 'Aggregate\nFeature Eng\nKPI Calc', '#C9A827'),
]
for x, text, color in mode_labels:
    ax_sankey.text(x, -0.15, text, ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=5, color=color, fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.7)

# Title for main panel
ax_sankey.text(3.0, 10.9, 'End-to-End Data Flow Pipeline',
               ha='center', va='top', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a')

# Source category legend
legend_items = [

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data['architecture_nodes']['data']
edges_data = data['architecture_edges']['data']
governance_data = data['governance_controls']['data']
transformations_data = data['transformation_summary']['data']

# ── Color palette ──
layer_colors = {
    'source':     '#2E6DA4',
    'ingestion':  '#D97B28',
    'bronze':     '#8B5E3C',
    'silver':     '#7B8D8E',
    'gold':       '#C9A827',
    'consumption':'#3A8F5C',
}

layer_bg = {
    'source':     '#D6E8F5',
    'ingestion':  '#FCE8D0',
    'bronze':     '#E8D5C0',
    'silver':     '#DDE3E3',
    'gold':       '#F0E8C8',
    'consumption':'#D4EDDC',
}

source_cat_colors = {
    'IoT/Streaming':      '#2E6DA4',
    'Enterprise Apps':    '#5BA3CF',
    'Logs/Clickstream':   '#3A8F5C',
    'External/3rd Party': '#D4A843',
    'Databases':          '#8B5E8B',
}

consumption_cat_colors = {
    'BI':         '#3A8F5C',
    'ML':         '#2E6DA4',
    'API':        '#D97B28',
    'Reverse ETL':'#8B5E8B',
}

complexity_colors = {'low': '#7CB342', 'medium': '#FFB300', 'high': '#E53935'}

enforcement_colors = {
    'automated': '#2E6DA4',
    'policy-based': '#D97B28',
    'manual': '#888888',
    'scheduled': '#3A8F5C',
}

# ── Organize data ──
layers_ordered = ['source', 'ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption']
nodes_by_layer = {layer: [] for layer in layers_ordered}
for n in nodes_data:
    nodes_by_layer[n['layer']].append(n)

node_map = {n['node_id']: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Create figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(24, 14), facecolor='white')

# GridSpec: main Sankey area (left 70%), transformation panel (top-right 15%), governance panel (bottom-right 15%)
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[2.5, 1], height_ratios=[1, 1],
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.92, bottom=0.05,
                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.12)

ax_sankey = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_xform = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Sankey-style Alluvial Flow Diagram
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_sankey.set_xlim(-0.5, 6.5)
ax_sankey.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)
ax_sankey.axis('off')

# Column x positions for each layer
col_x = {'source': 0, 'ingestion': 1.2, 'bronze': 2.4, 'silver': 3.6, 'gold': 4.8, 'consumption': 6.0}

# Draw layer background bands
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.42, -0.3), 0.84, 11.1,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                          facecolor=layer_bg[layer], edgecolor=layer_colors[layer],
                          linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax_sankey.add_patch(rect)

# Layer header labels
layer_labels = {
    'source': 'SOURCE\nLAYER',
    'ingestion': 'INGESTION\nENGINE',
    'bronze': 'BRONZE\n(Raw)',
    'silver': 'SILVER\n(Curated)',
    'gold': 'GOLD\n(Business)',
    'consumption': 'CONSUMPTION\nENDPOINTS',
}

layer_volume_totals = {}
for n in nodes_data:
    layer = n['layer']
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb') or 0
    layer_volume_totals[layer] = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0) + vol

for layer, x in col_x.items():
    total_vol = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0)
    vol_text = f"{total_vol:,} GB/day" if total_vol > 0 else "Query-based"
    ax_sankey.text(x, 10.5, layer_labels[layer], ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=layer_colors[layer], zorder=5)
    ax_sankey.text(x, 9.6, vol_text, ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=6.5, fontstyle='italic', color='#555555', zorder=5)

# Position nodes vertically within each column
node_positions = {}
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    layer_nodes = nodes_by_layer[layer]
    n_nodes = len(layer_nodes)
    y_space = 8.5 / max(n_nodes, 1)
    y_start = 8.8
    for i, n in enumerate(layer_nodes):
        y = y_start - i * y_space
        node_positions[n['node_id']] = (x, y)

# Draw nodes as colored rectangles
node_rect_height = 0.55
for n in nodes_data:
    x, y = node_positions[n['node_id']]
    if n['layer'] == 'source':
        color = source_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['source'])
    elif n['layer'] == 'consumption':
        color = consumption_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['consumption'])
    else:
        color = layer_colors[n['layer']]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.38, y - node_rect_height/2), 0.76, node_rect_height,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.03",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='white',
                          linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
    ax_sankey.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb')
    label_text = n['label']
    if vol:
        label_text += f"\n{vol} GB/d"
    ax_sankey.text(x, y, label_text, ha='center', va='center',
                   fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=4,
                   path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0.5, foreground='#00000040')])

# Draw edges as curved connections with width proportional to volume
max_vol = max((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)

for e in edges_data:
    src_x, src_y = node_positions[e['source']]
    tgt_x, tgt_y = node_positions[e['target']]
    vol = e.get('volume_gb')
    if vol:
        line_width = 0.5 + 4.0 * (vol / max_vol)
        alpha = 0.15 + 0.35 * (vol / max_vol)
    else:
        line_width = 0.5
        alpha = 0.15

    src_layer = node_map[e['source']]['layer']
    color = layer_colors[src_layer]

    # Draw bezier-like curve
    mid_x = (src_x + tgt_x) / 2
    xs = np.linspace(src_x + 0.38, tgt_x - 0.38, 50)
    # Cubic bezier approximation
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, 50)
    ctrl1_x = src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.35
    ctrl2_x = src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.65
    ys = ((1-t)**3 * src_y + 3*(1-t)**2*t * src_y +
          3*(1-t)*t**2 * tgt_y + t**3 * tgt_y)

    ax_sankey.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=line_width, alpha=alpha,
                   solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

# Draw flow mode labels between layers
mode_labels = [
    (0.5, 'Streaming\nBatch\nCDC', '#555555'),
    (1.7, 'Schema\nValidation\nDQ Gates', '#2E6DA4'),
    (2.9, 'Dedup\nCleanse\nNormalize', '#8B5E3C'),
    (4.1, 'Enrich\nJoin\nConform', '#7B8D8E'),
    (5.3, 'Aggregate\nFeature Eng\nKPI Calc', '#C9A827'),
]
for x, text, color in mode_labels:
    ax_sankey.text(x, -0.15, text, ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=5, color=color, fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.7)

# Title for main panel
ax_sankey.text(3.0, 10.9, 'End-to-End Data Flow Pipeline',
               ha='center', va='top', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a')

# Source category legend
legend_items = [
    ('IoT/Streaming', source_cat_colors['IoT/Streaming']),
    ('Enterprise Apps', source_cat_colors['Enterprise Apps']),
    ('Logs/Clickstream', source_cat_colors['Logs/Clickstream']),

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data['architecture_nodes']['data']
edges_data = data['architecture_edges']['data']
governance_data = data['governance_controls']['data']
transformations_data = data['transformation_summary']['data']

# ── Color palette ──
layer_colors = {
    'source':     '#2E6DA4',
    'ingestion':  '#D97B28',
    'bronze':     '#8B5E3C',
    'silver':     '#7B8D8E',
    'gold':       '#C9A827',
    'consumption':'#3A8F5C',
}

layer_bg = {
    'source':     '#D6E8F5',
    'ingestion':  '#FCE8D0',
    'bronze':     '#E8D5C0',
    'silver':     '#DDE3E3',
    'gold':       '#F0E8C8',
    'consumption':'#D4EDDC',
}

source_cat_colors = {
    'IoT/Streaming':      '#2E6DA4',
    'Enterprise Apps':    '#5BA3CF',
    'Logs/Clickstream':   '#3A8F5C',
    'External/3rd Party': '#D4A843',
    'Databases':          '#8B5E8B',
}

consumption_cat_colors = {
    'BI':         '#3A8F5C',
    'ML':         '#2E6DA4',
    'API':        '#D97B28',
    'Reverse ETL':'#8B5E8B',
}

complexity_colors = {'low': '#7CB342', 'medium': '#FFB300', 'high': '#E53935'}

enforcement_colors = {
    'automated': '#2E6DA4',
    'policy-based': '#D97B28',
    'manual': '#888888',
    'scheduled': '#3A8F5C',
}

# ── Organize data ──
layers_ordered = ['source', 'ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption']
nodes_by_layer = {layer: [] for layer in layers_ordered}
for n in nodes_data:
    nodes_by_layer[n['layer']].append(n)

node_map = {n['node_id']: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Create figure ──
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(24, 14), facecolor='white')

# GridSpec: main Sankey area (left 70%), transformation panel (top-right 15%), governance panel (bottom-right 15%)
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[2.5, 1], height_ratios=[1, 1],
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.92, bottom=0.05,
                      wspace=0.08, hspace=0.12)

ax_sankey = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_xform = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Sankey-style Alluvial Flow Diagram
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_sankey.set_xlim(-0.5, 6.5)
ax_sankey.set_ylim(-0.5, 10.5)
ax_sankey.axis('off')

# Column x positions for each layer
col_x = {'source': 0, 'ingestion': 1.2, 'bronze': 2.4, 'silver': 3.6, 'gold': 4.8, 'consumption': 6.0}

# Draw layer background bands
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.42, -0.3), 0.84, 11.1,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                          facecolor=layer_bg[layer], edgecolor=layer_colors[layer],
                          linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax_sankey.add_patch(rect)

# Layer header labels
layer_labels = {
    'source': 'SOURCE\nLAYER',
    'ingestion': 'INGESTION\nENGINE',
    'bronze': 'BRONZE\n(Raw)',
    'silver': 'SILVER\n(Curated)',
    'gold': 'GOLD\n(Business)',
    'consumption': 'CONSUMPTION\nENDPOINTS',
}

layer_volume_totals = {}
for n in nodes_data:
    layer = n['layer']
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb') or 0
    layer_volume_totals[layer] = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0) + vol

for layer, x in col_x.items():
    total_vol = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0)
    vol_text = f"{total_vol:,} GB/day" if total_vol > 0 else "Query-based"
    ax_sankey.text(x, 10.5, layer_labels[layer], ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=layer_colors[layer], zorder=5)
    ax_sankey.text(x, 9.6, vol_text, ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=6.5, fontstyle='italic', color='#555555', zorder=5)

# Position nodes vertically within each column
node_positions = {}
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    layer_nodes = nodes_by_layer[layer]
    n_nodes = len(layer_nodes)
    y_space = 8.5 / max(n_nodes, 1)
    y_start = 8.8
    for i, n in enumerate(layer_nodes):
        y = y_start - i * y_space
        node_positions[n['node_id']] = (x, y)

# Draw nodes as colored rectangles
node_rect_height = 0.55
for n in nodes_data:
    x, y = node_positions[n['node_id']]
    if n['layer'] == 'source':
        color = source_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['source'])
    elif n['layer'] == 'consumption':
        color = consumption_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['consumption'])
    else:
        color = layer_colors[n['layer']]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.38, y - node_rect_height/2), 0.76, node_rect_height,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.03",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='white',
                          linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.9, zorder=3)
    ax_sankey.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb')
    label_text = n['label']
    if vol:
        label_text += f"\n{vol} GB/d"
    ax_sankey.text(x, y, label_text, ha='center', va='center',
                   fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=4,
                   path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0.5, foreground='#00000040')])

# Draw edges as curved connections with width proportional to volume
max_vol = max((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)

for e in edges_data:
    src_x, src_y = node_positions[e['source']]
    tgt_x, tgt_y = node_positions[e['target']]
    vol = e.get('volume_gb')
    if vol:
        line_width = 0.5 + 4.0 * (vol / max_vol)
        alpha = 0.15 + 0.35 * (vol / max_vol)
    else:
        line_width = 0.5
        alpha = 0.15

    src_layer = node_map[e['source']]['layer']
    color = layer_colors[src_layer]

    # Draw bezier-like curve
    mid_x = (src_x + tgt_x) / 2
    xs = np.linspace(src_x + 0.38, tgt_x - 0.38, 50)
    # Cubic bezier approximation
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, 50)
    ctrl1_x = src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.35
    ctrl2_x = src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.65
    ys = ((1-t)**3 * src_y + 3*(1-t)**2*t * src_y +
          3*(1-t)*t**2 * tgt_y + t**3 * tgt_y)

    ax_sankey.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=line_width, alpha=alpha,
                   solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

# Draw flow mode labels between layers
mode_labels = [
    (0.5, 'Streaming\nBatch\nCDC', '#555555'),
    (1.7, 'Schema\nValidation\nDQ Gates', '#2E6DA4'),
    (2.9, 'Dedup\nCleanse\nNormalize', '#8B5E3C'),
    (4.1, 'Enrich\nJoin\nConform', '#7B8D8E'),
    (5.3, 'Aggregate\nFeature Eng\nKPI Calc', '#C9A827'),
]
for x, text, color in mode_labels:
    ax_sankey.text(x, -0.15, text, ha='center', va='top',
                   fontsize=5, color=color, fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.7)

# Title for main panel
ax_sankey.text(3.0, 10.9, 'End-to-End Data Flow Pipeline',
               ha='center', va='top', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a')

# Source category legend
legend_items = [
    ('IoT/Streaming', source_cat_colors['IoT/Streaming']),
    ('Enterprise Apps', source_cat_colors['Enterprise Apps']),
    ('Logs/Clickstream', source_cat_colors['Logs/Clickstream']),
    ('External/3rd Party', source_cat_colors['External/3rd Party']),
    ('Databases', source_cat_colors['Databases']),
]
for i, (label, color) in enumerate(legend_items):
    ax_sankey.plot(-0.3, 8.5 - i * 0.45, 's', color=color, markersize=6)
    ax_sankey.text(-0.15, 8.5 - i * 0.45, label, fontsize=5.5, va='center', color='#333333')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Transformation Summary
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_xform.set_title('Transformation Summary by Medallion Layer', fontsize=10,
                    fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=10)

xform_layers = ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']
y_pos = 0
y_ticks = []
y_labels = []
bar_colors_list = []
bar_values = []
bar_positions = []
layer_boundaries = []

for layer in xform_layers:
    layer_xforms = [t for t in transformations_data if t['layer'] == layer]
    layer_start = y_pos
    for t in sorted(layer_xforms, key=lambda x: x['count'], reverse=True):
        bar_positions.append(y_pos)
        bar_values.append(t['count'])
        bar_colors_list.append(complexity_colors[t['complexity']])
        short_name = t['transformation_type']
        if len(short_name) > 30:
            short_name = short_name[:28] + '..'
        y_labels.append(short_name)
        y_ticks.append(y_pos)
        y_pos += 1
    if layer_xforms:
        layer_boundaries.append((layer_start, y_pos - 1, layer))
    y_pos += 0.5

bars = ax_xform.barh(bar_positions, bar_values, height=0.7,

# Add value labels

ax_xform.invert_yaxis()

# Complexity legend
for i, (comp, color) in enumerate(complexity_colors.items()):

                  f'■ {comp.title()}', fontsize=6, color=color, va='center')

ax_xform.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

ax_xform.spines['left'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
ax_xform.tick_params(axis='both', colors='#666666', labelsize=6)

gov_display_names = ['Ingestion', 'Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Consumption', 'Cross-Layer']

    ax_xform.text(max(bar_values) + 2.2, mid, layer.upper(),
                  va='center', ha='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
                  color='white',
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=color, alpha=0.85, edgecolor='none'))

# Complexity legend
comp_x = max(bar_values) + 1.5
comp_y = len(bar_positions) + 0.8
ax_xform.text(comp_x - 0.5, comp_y, 'Complexity:', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='#555555')
for i, (comp, color) in enumerate(complexity_colors.items()):
    ax_xform.text(comp_x - 0.5, comp_y + 0.5 + i * 0.5, f'■ {comp.title()}',

ax_gov.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
ax_gov.set_title('Data Governance Controls by Pipeline Stage', fontsize=10,
                  fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=12)
ax_gov.axis('off')

gov_layers_display = ['ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption', 'cross-layer']
y_pos = 0.97

for i, layer in enumerate(gov_layers_display):
    controls = [g for g in governance_data if g['layer'] == layer]
    if layer in layer_colors:
        layer_color = layer_colors[layer]
    else:
        layer_color = '#555555'

    display_name = layer.replace('-', ' ').title()

    # Layer header with colored bar
    ax_gov.text(0.0, y_pos, display_name, fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                color=layer_color, va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=layer_color, alpha=0.15,
                          edgecolor=layer_color, linewidth=0.5))
    y_pos -= 0.04

    for g in controls:
        enf = g['enforcement']
        enf_color = enforcement_colors.get(enf, '#888888')
        enf_marker = {'automated': '●', 'policy-based': '◆', 'manual': '○', 'scheduled': '◔'}.get(enf, '·')

        ax_gov.text(0.02, y_pos, enf_marker, fontsize=8, color=enf_color, va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='bold')
        ax_gov.text(0.055, y_pos, f"{g['control_type']}", fontsize=7, color='#333333', va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='medium')
        ax_gov.text(0.055, y_pos - 0.028, f"{g['tool']}  ·  {g['scope']}", fontsize=5.5,
                    color='#888888', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontstyle='italic')
        y_pos -= 0.072

    y_pos -= 0.015

# Enforcement legend
legend_y = y_pos - 0.01
ax_gov.text(0.0, legend_y, 'Enforcement Legend:', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold',
            color='#555555', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes)
legend_items_gov = [
    ('● Automated', enforcement_colors['automated']),
    ('◆ Policy-based', enforcement_colors['policy-based']),
    ('○ Manual', enforcement_colors['manual']),
    ('◔ Scheduled', enforcement_colors['scheduled']),
]
for j, (text, color) in enumerate(legend_items_gov):
    ax_gov.text(0.02 + j * 0.25, legend_y - 0.035, text, fontsize=6,
                color=color, va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='bold')

# Governance cross-cutting annotation
ax_gov.text(0.0, legend_y - 0.075, 'Cross-layer controls span all pipeline stages\n'

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.collections import LineCollection

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data['architecture_nodes']['data']
edges_data = data['architecture_edges']['data']
governance_data = data['governance_controls']['data']
transformations_data = data['transformation_summary']['data']

# ── Color palette ──
layer_colors = {
    'source':     '#2E6DA4',
    'ingestion':  '#D97B28',
    'bronze':     '#8B5E3C',
    'silver':     '#7B8D8E',
    'gold':       '#C9A827',
    'consumption':'#3A8F5C',
}

layer_bg = {
    'source':     '#DAEAF5',
    'ingestion':  '#FDE8D0',
    'bronze':     '#EDD9C4',
    'silver':     '#E0E6E6',
    'gold':       '#F5EDD0',
    'consumption':'#D8F0E0',
}

source_cat_colors = {
    'IoT/Streaming':      '#2E6DA4',
    'Enterprise Apps':    '#5BA3CF',
    'Logs/Clickstream':   '#3A8F5C',
    'External/3rd Party': '#D4A843',
    'Databases':          '#8B5E8B',
}

consumption_cat_colors = {
    'BI':         '#3A8F5C',
    'ML':         '#2E6DA4',
    'API':        '#D97B28',
    'Reverse ETL':'#8B5E8B',
}

complexity_colors = {'low': '#7CB342', 'medium': '#FFB300', 'high': '#E53935'}

enforcement_colors = {
    'automated': '#2E6DA4',
    'policy-based': '#D97B28',
    'manual': '#888888',
    'scheduled': '#3A8F5C',
}

# ── Organize data ──
layers_ordered = ['source', 'ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption']
nodes_by_layer = {layer: [] for layer in layers_ordered}
for n in nodes_data:
    nodes_by_layer[n['layer']].append(n)

node_map = {n['node_id']: n for n in nodes_data}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# Create figure with 3-panel layout
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(26, 14), facecolor='#FAFAFA')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[2.8, 1], height_ratios=[1, 1],
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.91, bottom=0.04,
                      wspace=0.06, hspace=0.14)

ax_flow = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_xform = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Alluvial Flow Diagram
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_flow.set_xlim(-0.8, 7.0)
ax_flow.set_ylim(-1.2, 11.5)
ax_flow.axis('off')

# Column x positions
col_x = {'source': 0.0, 'ingestion': 1.3, 'bronze': 2.6, 'silver': 3.9, 'gold': 5.2, 'consumption': 6.5}

# Draw layer background bands
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.5, -0.6), 1.0, 11.5,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                          facecolor=layer_bg[layer], edgecolor=layer_colors[layer],
                          linewidth=2, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
    ax_flow.add_patch(rect)

# Layer header labels with volume totals
layer_labels_map = {
    'source': 'SOURCE\nLAYER',
    'ingestion': 'INGESTION\nENGINE',
    'bronze': 'BRONZE\n(Raw)',
    'silver': 'SILVER\n(Curated)',
    'gold': 'GOLD\n(Business)',
    'consumption': 'CONSUMPTION\nENDPOINTS',
}

layer_volume_totals = {}
for n in nodes_data:
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb') or 0
    layer_volume_totals[n['layer']] = layer_volume_totals.get(n['layer'], 0) + vol

for layer, x in col_x.items():
    total_vol = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0)
    vol_text = f"{total_vol:,} GB/day" if total_vol > 0 else "Query-based"
    ax_flow.text(x, 10.9, layer_labels_map[layer], ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=layer_colors[layer], zorder=5)
    ax_flow.text(x, 10.1, vol_text, ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=7, fontstyle='italic', color='#444444', zorder=5)

# Position nodes vertically
node_positions = {}
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    layer_nodes = nodes_by_layer[layer]
    n_nodes = len(layer_nodes)
    y_space = 8.2 / max(n_nodes, 1)
    y_start = 9.4
    for i, n in enumerate(layer_nodes):
        y = y_start - i * y_space
        node_positions[n['node_id']] = (x, y)

# Draw edges FIRST (behind nodes) with improved visibility
max_vol = max((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)
min_vol = min((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)

for e in edges_data:
    src_x, src_y = node_positions[e['source']]
    tgt_x, tgt_y = node_positions[e['target']]
    vol = e.get('volume_gb')

    if vol:
        # Logarithmic scaling for better visual differentiation
        norm_vol = np.log1p(vol) / np.log1p(max_vol)
        line_width = 1.0 + 7.0 * norm_vol
        alpha = 0.12 + 0.40 * norm_vol
    else:
        line_width = 0.8
        alpha = 0.12

    src_layer = node_map[e['source']]['layer']
    color = layer_colors[src_layer]

    # Bezier curve
    n_pts = 60
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n_pts)
    p0 = np.array([src_x + 0.45, src_y])
    p1 = np.array([src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.4, src_y])
    p2 = np.array([src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.6, tgt_y])
    p3 = np.array([tgt_x - 0.45, tgt_y])

    xs = (1-t)**3 * p0[0] + 3*(1-t)**2*t * p1[0] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * p2[0] + t**3 * p3[0]
    ys = (1-t)**3 * p0[1] + 3*(1-t)**2*t * p1[1] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * p2[1] + t**3 * p3[1]

    ax_flow.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=line_width, alpha=alpha,
                 solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

# Draw nodes as colored rounded rectangles
node_rect_h = 0.62
for n in nodes_data:
    x, y = node_positions[n['node_id']]
    if n['layer'] == 'source':
        color = source_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['source'])
    elif n['layer'] == 'consumption':
        color = consumption_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['consumption'])
    else:
        color = layer_colors[n['layer']]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.43, y - node_rect_h/2), 0.86, node_rect_h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='white',
                          linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.92, zorder=3)
    ax_flow.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb')
    label_text = n['label']
    if vol:
        label_text += f"\n{vol} GB/d"
    ax_flow.text(x, y, label_text, ha='center', va='center',
                 fontsize=6, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=4,
                 path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0.8, foreground='#00000030')])

# Flow mode annotations between layers
mode_annotations = [
    (0.65, 'Streaming│Batch│CDC', '#555555'),
    (1.95, 'Schema Valid.\nDQ Gates', '#2E6DA4'),
    (3.25, 'Dedup │ Cleanse\nNormalize', '#8B5E3C'),
    (4.55, 'Enrich │ Join\nConform │ Mask', '#7B8D8E'),
    (5.85, 'Aggregate │ KPI\nFeature Eng │ Views', '#C9A827'),
]
for x, text, color in mode_annotations:
    ax_flow.text(x, -0.7, text, ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=5.5, color=color, fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.65)

# Arrow indicators for flow direction
for i in range(5):
    x_start = list(col_x.values())[i] + 0.55
    x_end = list(col_x.values())[i+1] - 0.55
    x_mid = (x_start + x_end) / 2
    ax_flow.annotate('', xy=(x_end, -0.95), xytext=(x_start, -0.95),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=1.2))

# Source category legend
legend_items_src = [
    ('IoT/Streaming', source_cat_colors['IoT/Streaming']),
    ('Enterprise Apps', source_cat_colors['Enterprise Apps']),
    ('Logs/Clickstream', source_cat_colors['Logs/Clickstream']),
    ('External/3rd Party', source_cat_colors['External/3rd Party']),
    ('Databases', source_cat_colors['Databases']),
]
ax_flow.text(-0.5, -0.7, 'Source Categories:', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
             color='#333333', va='top')
for i, (label, color) in enumerate(legend_items_src):
    ax_flow.plot(-0.45, -1.1 - i * 0.25, 's', color=color, markersize=5)
    ax_flow.text(-0.25, -1.1 - i * 0.25, label, fontsize=5.5, va='center', color='#333333')

# Volume legend
ax_flow.text(1.5, -0.7, 'Volume Scale:', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
             color='#333333', va='top')
vol_legend_items = [('High (>300 GB)', 5.0), ('Medium (50-300 GB)', 3.0), ('Low (<50 GB)', 1.5)]
for i, (label, lw) in enumerate(vol_legend_items):
    y_lg = -1.1 - i * 0.25
    ax_flow.plot([1.5, 2.2], [y_lg, y_lg], color='#888888', linewidth=lw, alpha=0.5)
    ax_flow.text(2.3, y_lg, label, fontsize=5.5, va='center', color='#333333')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Transformation Summary
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_xform.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
ax_xform.set_title('Transformation Summary by Medallion Layer', fontsize=10,
                    fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=12)

xform_layers = ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']
bar_positions = []
bar_values = []
bar_colors_list = []
y_labels = []
layer_ranges = []
y_pos = 0

for layer in xform_layers:
    layer_xforms = sorted([t for t in transformations_data if t['layer'] == layer],
                           key=lambda x: x['count'], reverse=True)
    start_y = y_pos
    for t in layer_xforms:
        bar_positions.append(y_pos)
        bar_values.append(t['count'])
        bar_colors_list.append(complexity_colors[t['complexity']])
        y_labels.append(t['transformation_type'])
        y_pos += 1
    if layer_xforms:
        layer_ranges.append((start_y, y_pos - 1, layer))
    y_pos += 0.4

bars = ax_xform.barh(bar_positions, bar_values, height=0.65,
                      color=bar_colors_list, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85)

for bar, val in zip(bars, bar_values):
    ax_xform.text(bar.get_width() + 0.15, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                  str(val), va='center', fontsize=7, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')

ax_xform.set_yticks(bar_positions)
ax_xform.set_yticklabels(y_labels, fontsize=6.5)
ax_xform.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=7, color='#555555')
ax_xform.invert_yaxis()
ax_xform.set_xlim(0, max(bar_values) + 2.5)

# Layer background shading
for start, end, layer in layer_ranges:
    color = layer_colors[layer]
    ax_xform.axhspan(start - 0.4, end + 0.4, alpha=0.08, color=color, zorder=0)
    mid = (start + end) / 2
    ax_xform.text(max(bar_values) + 2.2, mid, layer.upper(),
                  va='center', ha='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
                  color='white',
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=color, alpha=0.85, edgecolor='none'))

# Complexity legend
comp_x = max(bar_values) + 1.5
comp_y = len(bar_positions) + 0.8
ax_xform.text(comp_x - 0.5, comp_y, 'Complexity:', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='#555555')
for i, (comp, color) in enumerate(complexity_colors.items()):
    ax_xform.text(comp_x - 0.5, comp_y + 0.5 + i * 0.5, f'■ {comp.title()}',
                  fontsize=6, color=color, fontweight='bold')

ax_xform.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_xform.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_xform.spines['bottom'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
ax_xform.spines['left'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
ax_xform.tick_params(axis='both', colors='#666666', labelsize=6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3: Governance Controls
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_gov.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
ax_gov.set_title('Data Governance Controls by Pipeline Stage', fontsize=10,
                  fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=12)
ax_gov.axis('off')

gov_layers_display = ['ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption', 'cross-layer']
y_pos = 0.97

for i, layer in enumerate(gov_layers_display):
    controls = [g for g in governance_data if g['layer'] == layer]
    if layer in layer_colors:
        layer_color = layer_colors[layer]
    else:
        layer_color = '#555555'

    display_name = layer.replace('-', ' ').title()

    # Layer header with colored bar
    ax_gov.text(0.0, y_pos, display_name, fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                color=layer_color, va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=layer_color, alpha=0.15,
                          edgecolor=layer_color, linewidth=0.5))
    y_pos -= 0.04

    for g in controls:
        enf = g['enforcement']
        enf_color = enforcement_colors.get(enf, '#888888')
        enf_marker = {'automated': '●', 'policy-based': '◆', 'manual': '○', 'scheduled': '◔'}.get(enf, '·')

        ax_gov.text(0.02, y_pos, enf_marker, fontsize=8, color=enf_color, va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='bold')
        ax_gov.text(0.055, y_pos, f"{g['control_type']}", fontsize=7, color='#333333', va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='medium')
        ax_gov.text(0.055, y_pos - 0.028, f"{g['tool']}  ·  {g['scope']}", fontsize=5.5,
                    color='#888888', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontstyle='italic')
        y_pos -= 0.072

    y_pos -= 0.015

# Enforcement legend
legend_y = y_pos - 0.01
ax_gov.text(0.0, legend_y, 'Enforcement Legend:', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold',
            color='#555555', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes)
legend_items_gov = [
    ('● Automated', enforcement_colors['automated']),
    ('◆ Policy-based', enforcement_colors['policy-based']),
    ('○ Manual', enforcement_colors['manual']),
    ('◔ Scheduled', enforcement_colors['scheduled']),
]
for j, (text, color) in enumerate(legend_items_gov):
    ax_gov.text(0.02 + j * 0.25, legend_y - 0.035, text, fontsize=6,
                color=color, va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='bold')

# Governance cross-cutting annotation
ax_gov.text(0.0, legend_y - 0.075, 'Cross-layer controls span all pipeline stages\n'
            'ensuring end-to-end lineage, classification & compliance',
            fontsize=5.5, color='#555555', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes,
            fontstyle='italic',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#F0F0F0', edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
                      linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# Main figure title
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle('Data Lakehouse Architecture — Pipeline Flow, Volume Throughput & Governance',
             fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', y=0.97,
             fontfamily='sans-serif')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='#FAFAFA', edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.3)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import matplotlib.colors as mcolors
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.collections import LineCollection

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data['architecture_nodes']['data']
edges_data = data['architecture_edges']['data']
governance_data = data['governance_controls']['data']
transformations_data = data['transformation_summary']['data']

# ── Color palette ──
layer_colors = {
    'source':     '#2E6DA4',
    'ingestion':  '#D97B28',
    'bronze':     '#8B5E3C',
    'silver':     '#7B8D8E',
    'gold':       '#C9A827',
    'consumption':'#3A8F5C',
}

layer_bg = {
    'source':     '#DAEAF5',
    'ingestion':  '#FDE8D0',
    'bronze':     '#EDD9C4',
    'silver':     '#E0E6E6',
    'gold':       '#F5EDD0',
    'consumption':'#D8F0E0',
}

source_cat_colors = {
    'IoT/Streaming':      '#2E6DA4',
    'Enterprise Apps':    '#5BA3CF',
    'Logs/Clickstream':   '#3A8F5C',
    'External/3rd Party': '#D4A843',
    'Databases':          '#8B5E8B',
}

consumption_cat_colors = {
    'BI':         '#3A8F5C',
    'ML':         '#2E6DA4',
    'API':        '#D97B28',
    'Reverse ETL':'#8B5E8B',
}

complexity_colors = {'low': '#7CB342', 'medium': '#FFB300', 'high': '#E53935'}

enforcement_colors = {
    'automated': '#2E6DA4',
    'policy-based': '#D97B28',
    'manual': '#888888',
    'scheduled': '#3A8F5C',
}

# ── Organize data ──
layers_ordered = ['source', 'ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption']
nodes_by_layer = {layer: [] for layer in layers_ordered}
for n in nodes_data:
    nodes_by_layer[n['layer']].append(n)

node_map = {n['node_id']: n for n in nodes_data}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# Create figure with 3-panel layout
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(26, 14), facecolor='#FAFAFA')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=[2.8, 1], height_ratios=[1, 1],
                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.91, bottom=0.04,
                      wspace=0.06, hspace=0.14)

ax_flow = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_xform = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Alluvial Flow Diagram
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_flow.set_xlim(-0.8, 7.0)
ax_flow.set_ylim(-1.2, 11.5)
ax_flow.axis('off')

# Column x positions
col_x = {'source': 0.0, 'ingestion': 1.3, 'bronze': 2.6, 'silver': 3.9, 'gold': 5.2, 'consumption': 6.5}

# Draw layer background bands
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.5, -0.6), 1.0, 11.5,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                          facecolor=layer_bg[layer], edgecolor=layer_colors[layer],
                          linewidth=2, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
    ax_flow.add_patch(rect)

# Layer header labels with volume totals
layer_labels_map = {
    'source': 'SOURCE\nLAYER',
    'ingestion': 'INGESTION\nENGINE',
    'bronze': 'BRONZE\n(Raw)',
    'silver': 'SILVER\n(Curated)',
    'gold': 'GOLD\n(Business)',
    'consumption': 'CONSUMPTION\nENDPOINTS',
}

layer_volume_totals = {}
for n in nodes_data:
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb') or 0
    layer_volume_totals[n['layer']] = layer_volume_totals.get(n['layer'], 0) + vol

for layer, x in col_x.items():
    total_vol = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0)
    vol_text = f"{total_vol:,} GB/day" if total_vol > 0 else "Query-based"
    ax_flow.text(x, 10.9, layer_labels_map[layer], ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=layer_colors[layer], zorder=5)
    ax_flow.text(x, 10.1, vol_text, ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=7, fontstyle='italic', color='#444444', zorder=5)

# Position nodes vertically
node_positions = {}
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    layer_nodes = nodes_by_layer[layer]
    n_nodes = len(layer_nodes)
    y_space = 8.2 / max(n_nodes, 1)
    y_start = 9.4
    for i, n in enumerate(layer_nodes):
        y = y_start - i * y_space
        node_positions[n['node_id']] = (x, y)

# Draw edges FIRST (behind nodes) with improved visibility
max_vol = max((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)
min_vol = min((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)

for e in edges_data:
    src_x, src_y = node_positions[e['source']]
    tgt_x, tgt_y = node_positions[e['target']]
    vol = e.get('volume_gb')

    if vol:
        # Logarithmic scaling for better visual differentiation
        norm_vol = np.log1p(vol) / np.log1p(max_vol)
        line_width = 1.0 + 7.0 * norm_vol
        alpha = 0.12 + 0.40 * norm_vol
    else:
        line_width = 0.8
        alpha = 0.12

    src_layer = node_map[e['source']]['layer']
    color = layer_colors[src_layer]

    # Bezier curve
    n_pts = 60
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n_pts)
    p0 = np.array([src_x + 0.45, src_y])
    p1 = np.array([src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.4, src_y])
    p2 = np.array([src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.6, tgt_y])
    p3 = np.array([tgt_x - 0.45, tgt_y])

    xs = (1-t)**3 * p0[0] + 3*(1-t)**2*t * p1[0] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * p2[0] + t**3 * p3[0]
    ys = (1-t)**3 * p0[1] + 3*(1-t)**2*t * p1[1] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * p2[1] + t**3 * p3[1]

    ax_flow.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=line_width, alpha=alpha,
                 solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

# Draw nodes as colored rounded rectangles
node_rect_h = 0.62
for n in nodes_data:
    x, y = node_positions[n['node_id']]
    if n['layer'] == 'source':
        color = source_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['source'])
    elif n['layer'] == 'consumption':
        color = consumption_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['consumption'])
    else:
        color = layer_colors[n['layer']]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.43, y - node_rect_h/2), 0.86, node_rect_h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='white',
                          linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.92, zorder=3)
    ax_flow.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb')
    label_text = n['label']
    if vol:
        label_text += f"\n{vol} GB/d"
    ax_flow.text(x, y, label_text, ha='center', va='center',
                 fontsize=6, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=4,
                 path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0.8, foreground='#00000030')])

# Flow mode annotations between layers
mode_annotations = [
    (0.65, 'Streaming│Batch│CDC', '#555555'),
    (1.95, 'Schema Valid.\nDQ Gates', '#2E6DA4'),
    (3.25, 'Dedup │ Cleanse\nNormalize', '#8B5E3C'),
    (4.55, 'Enrich │ Join\nConform │ Mask', '#7B8D8E'),
    (5.85, 'Aggregate │ KPI\nFeature Eng │ Views', '#C9A827'),
]
for x, text, color in mode_annotations:
    ax_flow.text(x, -0.7, text, ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=5.5, color=color, fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.65)

# Arrow indicators for flow direction
for i in range(5):
    x_start = list(col_x.values())[i] + 0.55
    x_end = list(col_x.values())[i+1] - 0.55
    x_mid = (x_start + x_end) / 2
    ax_flow.annotate('', xy=(x_end, -0.95), xytext=(x_start, -0.95),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=1.2))

# Source category legend
legend_items_src = [
    ('IoT/Streaming', source_cat_colors['IoT/Streaming']),
    ('Enterprise Apps', source_cat_colors['Enterprise Apps']),
    ('Logs/Clickstream', source_cat_colors['Logs/Clickstream']),
    ('External/3rd Party', source_cat_colors['External/3rd Party']),
    ('Databases', source_cat_colors['Databases']),
]
ax_flow.text(-0.5, -0.7, 'Source Categories:', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
             color='#333333', va='top')
for i, (label, color) in enumerate(legend_items_src):
    ax_flow.plot(-0.45, -1.1 - i * 0.25, 's', color=color, markersize=5)
    ax_flow.text(-0.25, -1.1 - i * 0.25, label, fontsize=5.5, va='center', color='#333333')

# Volume legend
ax_flow.text(1.5, -0.7, 'Volume Scale:', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
             color='#333333', va='top')
vol_legend_items = [('High (>300 GB)', 5.0), ('Medium (50-300 GB)', 3.0), ('Low (<50 GB)', 1.5)]
for i, (label, lw) in enumerate(vol_legend_items):
    y_lg = -1.1 - i * 0.25
    ax_flow.plot([1.5, 2.2], [y_lg, y_lg], color='#888888', linewidth=lw, alpha=0.5)
    ax_flow.text(2.3, y_lg, label, fontsize=5.5, va='center', color='#333333')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Transformation Summary
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_xform.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
ax_xform.set_title('Transformation Summary by Medallion Layer', fontsize=10,
                    fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=12)

xform_layers = ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']
bar_positions = []
bar_values = []
bar_colors_list = []
y_labels = []
layer_ranges = []
y_pos = 0

for layer in xform_layers:
    layer_xforms = sorted([t for t in transformations_data if t['layer'] == layer],
                           key=lambda x: x['count'], reverse=True)
    start_y = y_pos
    for t in layer_xforms:
        bar_positions.append(y_pos)
        bar_values.append(t['count'])
        bar_colors_list.append(complexity_colors[t['complexity']])
        y_labels.append(t['transformation_type'])
        y_pos += 1
    if layer_xforms:

    y_pos += 0.4

                      color=bar_colors_list, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85)

for bar, val in zip(bars, bar_values):

ax_xform.set_yticks(bar_positions)
ax_xform.set_yticklabels(y_labels, fontsize=6.5)
ax_xform.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=7, color='#555555')
ax_xform.invert_yaxis()
ax_xform.set_xlim(0, max(bar_values) + 2.5)

# Layer background shading
for start, end, layer in layer_ranges:

                      left=0.02, right=0.98, top=0.91, bottom=0.04,
                      wspace=0.06, hspace=0.14)

ax_flow = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
ax_xform = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_gov = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1: Alluvial Flow Diagram
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_flow.set_xlim(-0.8, 7.0)
ax_flow.set_ylim(-1.2, 11.5)
ax_flow.axis('off')

# Column x positions
col_x = {'source': 0.0, 'ingestion': 1.3, 'bronze': 2.6, 'silver': 3.9, 'gold': 5.2, 'consumption': 6.5}

# Draw layer background bands
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.5, -0.6), 1.0, 11.5,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                          facecolor=layer_bg[layer], edgecolor=layer_colors[layer],
                          linewidth=2, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)
    ax_flow.add_patch(rect)

# Layer header labels with volume totals
layer_labels_map = {
    'source': 'SOURCE\nLAYER',
    'ingestion': 'INGESTION\nENGINE',
    'bronze': 'BRONZE\n(Raw)',
    'silver': 'SILVER\n(Curated)',
    'gold': 'GOLD\n(Business)',
    'consumption': 'CONSUMPTION\nENDPOINTS',
}

layer_volume_totals = {}
for n in nodes_data:
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb') or 0
    layer_volume_totals[n['layer']] = layer_volume_totals.get(n['layer'], 0) + vol

for layer, x in col_x.items():
    total_vol = layer_volume_totals.get(layer, 0)
    vol_text = f"{total_vol:,} GB/day" if total_vol > 0 else "Query-based"
    ax_flow.text(x, 10.9, layer_labels_map[layer], ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=layer_colors[layer], zorder=5)
    ax_flow.text(x, 10.1, vol_text, ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=7, fontstyle='italic', color='#444444', zorder=5)

# Position nodes vertically
node_positions = {}
for layer, x in col_x.items():
    layer_nodes = nodes_by_layer[layer]
    n_nodes = len(layer_nodes)
    y_space = 8.2 / max(n_nodes, 1)
    y_start = 9.4
    for i, n in enumerate(layer_nodes):
        y = y_start - i * y_space
        node_positions[n['node_id']] = (x, y)

# Draw edges FIRST (behind nodes) with improved visibility
max_vol = max((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)
min_vol = min((e['volume_gb'] for e in edges_data if e.get('volume_gb')), default=1)

for e in edges_data:
    src_x, src_y = node_positions[e['source']]
    tgt_x, tgt_y = node_positions[e['target']]
    vol = e.get('volume_gb')

    if vol:
        # Logarithmic scaling for better visual differentiation
        norm_vol = np.log1p(vol) / np.log1p(max_vol)
        line_width = 1.0 + 7.0 * norm_vol
        alpha = 0.12 + 0.40 * norm_vol
    else:
        line_width = 0.8
        alpha = 0.12

    src_layer = node_map[e['source']]['layer']
    color = layer_colors[src_layer]

    # Bezier curve
    n_pts = 60
    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n_pts)
    p0 = np.array([src_x + 0.45, src_y])
    p1 = np.array([src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.4, src_y])
    p2 = np.array([src_x + (tgt_x - src_x) * 0.6, tgt_y])
    p3 = np.array([tgt_x - 0.45, tgt_y])

    xs = (1-t)**3 * p0[0] + 3*(1-t)**2*t * p1[0] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * p2[0] + t**3 * p3[0]
    ys = (1-t)**3 * p0[1] + 3*(1-t)**2*t * p1[1] + 3*(1-t)*t**2 * p2[1] + t**3 * p3[1]

    ax_flow.plot(xs, ys, color=color, linewidth=line_width, alpha=alpha,
                 solid_capstyle='round', zorder=1)

# Draw nodes as colored rounded rectangles
node_rect_h = 0.62
for n in nodes_data:
    x, y = node_positions[n['node_id']]
    if n['layer'] == 'source':
        color = source_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['source'])
    elif n['layer'] == 'consumption':
        color = consumption_cat_colors.get(n['category'], layer_colors['consumption'])
    else:
        color = layer_colors[n['layer']]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 0.43, y - node_rect_h/2), 0.86, node_rect_h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0.04",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='white',
                          linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.92, zorder=3)
    ax_flow.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    vol = n.get('daily_volume_gb')
    label_text = n['label']
    if vol:
        label_text += f"\n{vol} GB/d"
    ax_flow.text(x, y, label_text, ha='center', va='center',
                 fontsize=6, fontweight='bold', color='white', zorder=4,
                 path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=0.8, foreground='#00000030')])

# Flow mode annotations between layers
mode_annotations = [
    (0.65, 'Streaming│Batch│CDC', '#555555'),
    (1.95, 'Schema Valid.\nDQ Gates', '#2E6DA4'),
    (3.25, 'Dedup │ Cleanse\nNormalize', '#8B5E3C'),
    (4.55, 'Enrich │ Join\nConform │ Mask', '#7B8D8E'),
    (5.85, 'Aggregate │ KPI\nFeature Eng │ Views', '#C9A827'),
]
for x, text, color in mode_annotations:
    ax_flow.text(x, -0.7, text, ha='center', va='top',
                 fontsize=5.5, color=color, fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.65)

# Arrow indicators for flow direction
for i in range(5):
    x_start = list(col_x.values())[i] + 0.55
    x_end = list(col_x.values())[i+1] - 0.55
    x_mid = (x_start + x_end) / 2
    ax_flow.annotate('', xy=(x_end, -0.95), xytext=(x_start, -0.95),
                     arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=1.2))

# Source category legend
legend_items_src = [
    ('IoT/Streaming', source_cat_colors['IoT/Streaming']),
    ('Enterprise Apps', source_cat_colors['Enterprise Apps']),
    ('Logs/Clickstream', source_cat_colors['Logs/Clickstream']),
    ('External/3rd Party', source_cat_colors['External/3rd Party']),
    ('Databases', source_cat_colors['Databases']),
]
ax_flow.text(-0.5, -0.7, 'Source Categories:', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
             color='#333333', va='top')
for i, (label, color) in enumerate(legend_items_src):
    ax_flow.plot(-0.45, -1.1 - i * 0.25, 's', color=color, markersize=5)
    ax_flow.text(-0.25, -1.1 - i * 0.25, label, fontsize=5.5, va='center', color='#333333')

# Volume legend
ax_flow.text(1.5, -0.7, 'Volume Scale:', fontsize=6, fontweight='bold',
             color='#333333', va='top')
vol_legend_items = [('High (>300 GB)', 5.0), ('Medium (50-300 GB)', 3.0), ('Low (<50 GB)', 1.5)]
for i, (label, lw) in enumerate(vol_legend_items):
    y_lg = -1.1 - i * 0.25
    ax_flow.plot([1.5, 2.2], [y_lg, y_lg], color='#888888', linewidth=lw, alpha=0.5)
    ax_flow.text(2.3, y_lg, label, fontsize=5.5, va='center', color='#333333')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2: Transformation Summary
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_xform.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
ax_xform.set_title('Transformation Summary by Medallion Layer', fontsize=10,
                    fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=12)

xform_layers = ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']
bar_positions = []
bar_values = []
bar_colors_list = []
y_labels = []
layer_ranges = []
y_pos = 0

for layer in xform_layers:
    layer_xforms = sorted([t for t in transformations_data if t['layer'] == layer],
                           key=lambda x: x['count'], reverse=True)
    start_y = y_pos
    for t in layer_xforms:
        bar_positions.append(y_pos)
        bar_values.append(t['count'])
        bar_colors_list.append(complexity_colors[t['complexity']])
        y_labels.append(t['transformation_type'])
        y_pos += 1
    if layer_xforms:
        layer_ranges.append((start_y, y_pos - 1, layer))
    y_pos += 0.4

bars = ax_xform.barh(bar_positions, bar_values, height=0.65,
                      color=bar_colors_list, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85)

for bar, val in zip(bars, bar_values):
    ax_xform.text(bar.get_width() + 0.15, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                  str(val), va='center', fontsize=7, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')

ax_xform.set_yticks(bar_positions)
ax_xform.set_yticklabels(y_labels, fontsize=6.5)
ax_xform.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=7, color='#555555')
ax_xform.invert_yaxis()
ax_xform.set_xlim(0, max(bar_values) + 2.5)

# Layer background shading
for start, end, layer in layer_ranges:
    color = layer_colors[layer]
    ax_xform.axhspan(start - 0.4, end + 0.4, alpha=0.08, color=color, zorder=0)
    mid = (start + end) / 2
    ax_xform.text(max(bar_values) + 2.2, mid, layer.upper(),
                  va='center', ha='center', fontsize=7, fontweight='bold',
                  color='white',
                  bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=color, alpha=0.85, edgecolor='none'))

# Complexity legend
comp_x = max(bar_values) + 1.5
comp_y = len(bar_positions) + 0.8
ax_xform.text(comp_x - 0.5, comp_y, 'Complexity:', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='#555555')
for i, (comp, color) in enumerate(complexity_colors.items()):
    ax_xform.text(comp_x - 0.5, comp_y + 0.5 + i * 0.5, f'■ {comp.title()}',
                  fontsize=6, color=color, fontweight='bold')

ax_xform.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_xform.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax_xform.spines['bottom'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
ax_xform.spines['left'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
ax_xform.tick_params(axis='both', colors='#666666', labelsize=6)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3: Governance Controls
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
ax_gov.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
ax_gov.set_title('Data Governance Controls by Pipeline Stage', fontsize=10,
                  fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', pad=12)
ax_gov.axis('off')

gov_layers_display = ['ingestion', 'bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'consumption', 'cross-layer']
y_pos = 0.97

for i, layer in enumerate(gov_layers_display):
    controls = [g for g in governance_data if g['layer'] == layer]
    if layer in layer_colors:
        layer_color = layer_colors[layer]
    else:
        layer_color = '#555555'

    display_name = layer.replace('-', ' ').title()

    # Layer header with colored bar
    ax_gov.text(0.0, y_pos, display_name, fontsize=8, fontweight='bold',
                color=layer_color, va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor=layer_color, alpha=0.15,
                          edgecolor=layer_color, linewidth=0.5))
    y_pos -= 0.04

    for g in controls:
        enf = g['enforcement']
        enf_color = enforcement_colors.get(enf, '#888888')
        enf_marker = {'automated': '●', 'policy-based': '◆', 'manual': '○', 'scheduled': '◔'}.get(enf, '·')

        ax_gov.text(0.02, y_pos, enf_marker, fontsize=8, color=enf_color, va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='bold')
        ax_gov.text(0.055, y_pos, f"{g['control_type']}", fontsize=7, color='#333333', va='top',
                    transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='medium')
        ax_gov.text(0.055, y_pos - 0.028, f"{g['tool']}  ·  {g['scope']}", fontsize=5.5,
                    color='#888888', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontstyle='italic')
        y_pos -= 0.072

    y_pos -= 0.015

# Enforcement legend
legend_y = y_pos - 0.01
ax_gov.text(0.0, legend_y, 'Enforcement Legend:', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold',
            color='#555555', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes)
legend_items_gov = [
    ('● Automated', enforcement_colors['automated']),
    ('◆ Policy-based', enforcement_colors['policy-based']),
    ('○ Manual', enforcement_colors['manual']),
    ('◔ Scheduled', enforcement_colors['scheduled']),
]
for j, (text, color) in enumerate(legend_items_gov):
    ax_gov.text(0.02 + j * 0.25, legend_y - 0.035, text, fontsize=6,
                color=color, va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes, fontweight='bold')

# Governance cross-cutting annotation
ax_gov.text(0.0, legend_y - 0.075, 'Cross-layer controls span all pipeline stages\n'
            'ensuring end-to-end lineage, classification & compliance',
            fontsize=5.5, color='#555555', va='top', transform=ax_gov.transAxes,
            fontstyle='italic',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#F0F0F0', edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
                      linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.6))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# Main figure title
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle('Data Lakehouse Architecture — Pipeline Flow, Volume Throughput & Governance',
             fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a1a', y=0.97,
             fontfamily='sans-serif')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='#FAFAFA', edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.3)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
